candidates.proposal_rationale: Initial untried candidate: only the qualified baseline is captured; proposal/, reports/, and build/ contain no previous measurements or feedback. Keep the baseline physical configuration (utilization 40, density 0.55, abc_area 0, repair_margin 0) and enable both protocol-qualified mechanical RTL actions. The exact signed 18-bit reduction with sign extension may reduce arithmetic cell area and switching, although synthesis may already eliminate some redundant width. Masking multiply inputs except when accepting a request may reduce idle switching, at the cost of gating cells, control loading, and possible added input delay; workload-dependent net energy savings are not assumed. Preserve the baseline physical settings because setup slack is only 0.19292 ns at period 10526 ps; hold slack is 0.114491 ns, with zero max-slew, max-capacitance, and max-fanout violations. Avoid combining these RTL changes with a more aggressive mapping or placement change before measuring their timing impact.
